description: Land Acquisition - Tharapuram and Thalvupadu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Thalvupadu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Southbar, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders directing acquiring officers to take possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land acquisition, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters, making it a Land Gazette.
